title: OPS-02 Authoritative Parent Scene Identity and Independence Rules
purpose: Establish strict criteria for determining physical scene identity and independence to prevent data leakage and pseudo-replication in OPS-02 dataset expansion.

SAME_PARENT.definition: Identical physical SAR acquisition or slice thereof.
criteria: Identical Sentinel-1 complete product ID (e.g., S1A_IW_GRDH_1SDV_...).
Or identical raw datatake identifier and zero-Doppler time range.
Or spatial intersection >= 90% with acquisition time delta < 60 seconds.
SAME_PARENT.split_constraint: All tiles derived from the SAME_PARENT must reside in the exact same partition (TRAIN, DEV, or HOLDOUT). Never split across partitions.

RELATED_ACQUISITIONS.definition: Acquisitions with high physical, meteorological, or sea-state correlation.
criteria: Along-track adjacent slices from the same orbital pass (Delta t < 10 minutes).
Or same geographic footprint (spatial overlap >= 20%) acquired within Delta t <= 24 hours.
Or consecutive repeat-pass acquisitions under stable persistent weather systems.
RELATED_ACQUISITIONS.split_constraint: Must be assigned to the same partition as their related counterpart, or quarantined from evaluation splits.

POTENTIALLY_DEPENDENT.definition: Acquisitions sharing orbital geometry or partial spatial footprint within standard repeat cycle.
criteria: Same relative orbit track with spatial overlap >= 10% acquired within Delta t <= 12 days.
Or stationary anthropogenic target area (e.g. fixed oil platform or wind farm) regardless of time delta.
POTENTIALLY_DEPENDENT.split_constraint: Requires explicit spatial buffering (>= 15 km) and feature masking before cross-partition assignment; otherwise grouped into same partition.

INDEPENDENT.definition: Acquisitions capturing physically distinct, uncorrelated oceanographic and atmospheric states.
criteria: Geographically disjoint footprints (zero spatial intersection, distance between centroids >= 50 km).
Or overlapping footprints separated by Delta t >= 30 days under independently verified distinct synoptic wind/wave conditions.
Or different satellite tracks / relative orbits with negligible spatial overlap (< 5%) and uncorrelated acquisition timestamps.
INDEPENDENT.split_constraint: Eligible for partition assignment across TRAIN, DEV, or HOLDOUT.

forbidden_independence_heuristics: Never treat distinct slice filenames or crop identifiers from the same parent acquisition as independent.
Never treat augmented versions (flips, crops, rotations) as independent samples.
Never treat adjacent tiles within the same parent swath as independent evidence.
Never count multiple tiles containing the same rare phenomenon from a single parent as multiple independent parents.
default_rule: When independence between two candidate scenes is ambiguous or unverified, they must be treated as CONDITIONALLY_DEPENDENT and quarantined or co-partitioned. Never default to independent.
